Appearance:
 Shri K.D. Singh - Advocate for the applicant.
Smt. Sunita Sood - Panel Lawyer for the State.

Order 
This first bail application under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail in relation to FIR No.22/2024 dated 24.2.2024 registered at Police Station Janeh, District Rewa (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(3), 376(2)(n), 120B and 506 of IPC and Sections 5/6 of POCSO Act,2012.

Applicant is in detention since 13.3.2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, on 24.2.2024, prosecutrix mother lodged an FIR about missing of her daughter aged less than 16 years.
FIR was registered.
She was recovered on 1.3.2024.
After investigation charge sheet has been filed against the accused persons for commission of aforesaid offences.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:45963 2 MCRC-37092-2024 not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
The allegation of rape/aggravated penetrative sexual assault is against Deepak Kori.
The allegation of kidnapping is against him.
Referring to the statement of prosecutrix under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., it is contended that she has not named the present applicant in her earlier statement.
Later on, due to village rivalry, he has been enroped as accused.

It is contended by the counsel that on similar set of allegation, co-accused Dinesh Prasad Kori @ Panchu has already Atul @ Mithu Kori vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142496162/
1 been released on bail by this COurt on 01/08/2024 in M.Cr.C. No.32067/2024.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may also be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for the victim have opposed grant of bail.
5. I have gone through the statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C. and other material on record.

Having taken into consideration the entirety of allegations levelled against the present applicant including the fact that the co-accused Dinesh Prasad Kori @ Panchu Kori has already been released on bail by this Court on 01/08/2024 in M.Cr.C. No.32067/2024, but without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, this first bail application under Section 483 of BNSS/439 of Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Atul @ Mithun Kori be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:45963 3 MCRC-37092-2024 Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS/437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Astha Atul @ Mithu Kori vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142496162/
